notes:
All prices are copied exactly as shown. Some of the page's numbers look wrong or conflict with each other:
- Annual prices: Unlimited costs $297/Month but $4970/Year (line 71). Founder costs $497/Month but $2970/Year (line 57). These may be swapped on the page. They were recorded as shown.
- Plan name: the FAQ calls the $497/mo plan the "Pro Plan" (line 176), but the pricing card calls it "Founder" (line 55).
- Starter: the FAQ says Starter ($97/mo) includes 3 Sub-Accounts (line 175). Unlimited and Pro include unlimited Sub-Accounts (line 179).
- Enterprise plan: no price is listed; the page says "Speak with Our Enterprise Team" (line 80).
- AI Employee add-ons (lines 118-121) cost extra on top of a platform plan.
- Usage fees: AI, phone, SMS and email are charged by usage (lines 110-112 and 183). Usage fees may apply during the trial (line 188).
- Billing: it starts automatically when the trial ends unless canceled (line 188). Plans are month-to-month with no long-term contract (line 167).
- Other add-ons are listed at lines 122-143 (e.g., HIPAA $297/month, Premium support $500/month, White label mobile app $497/month).
- Setup fee: none is mentioned.
